name: Plastic Supply of Maine
old_description: The place for all your plastic fabrication, distribution and routing needs!
about:
Plastic Supply of Maine operates from Biddeford, Maine, at 6 Pomerleau Street. The company, also known as Plastic Supply Inc. of Maine, does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The business combines distribution with custom fabrication and precision machining. Its shop provides CNC routing, cut-to-size services, and on-site installation and fabrication. It stocks a full line of engineering plastic materials and sign materials, and also offers GSP foils, parts, and software. The company lists capabilities including custom fabrication, CNC routing, cut to size, and on-site installation/fabrication, positioning itself as a single source for plastic fabrication, distribution, and routing needs.

The company serves the signage industry with dedicated sign supplies and materials, and supports broader industrial customers needing plastic fabrication and machining. Its product offerings include custom plastic fabrication and CNC routing, as well as GSP foils, parts, and software.

The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or differentiator beyond its combined distribution and fabrication offering.
